findings.title: Nil receiver relies on validate for error
findings.message: Not a crash: validate handles a nil receiver, and the early return is correct. But the deferred revision/identity update is skipped for nil, which is fine. No action required beyond noting reliance on validate's nil check.
findings.suggestion: Return an explicit error for nil instead of relying on the validate side effect.

findings.title: Panic on image creation error inside View
findings.message: capacityImage panics if image construction fails, which would crash the UI from a View call even though View already returns an error. A constant-size image should not fail, but the panic path is unnecessary and capacityImage's signature hides the error.
findings.suggestion: Return (*canvas.TiledImage, error) from capacityImage and propagate the error from View.
